surface-raised.$description: Cards, bottom sheets, search bar, filter chips at rest.

sandstone.$description: Map ground, dividers, progress-bar track, outlined-area fill under a 12% olive wash.

ink.$description: Primary text and headings on surface and surface-raised; the ground bar in the mark on light grounds.

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text, labels, inactive tab icons. Passes 4.5:1 on surface in both themes.

olive.$description: Brand color. Primary buttons, active filter chip, visited map pins, progress fill, links.

sol.$description: Accent. The dot in the mark, follow-up pins, the Follow up button. Use sparingly: it always means someone to see.

on-sol.$description: Text and icons on sol. Never white on sol.

sol-tint.$description: Follow-up badge background, with ink text.

basalt.$description: Fixed dark brand ground: app icon, splash screen, greeting card on the map, merch. Same in both themes.

on-basalt.$description: Text and the ground bar of the mark on basalt.
